description: A portable ADS-B receiver's GDL 90 bytes (Garmin 560-1058-00 Rev A; ForeFlight's ID message) read into what it has said: its state, own ship, the traffic it hears (AIM 4-5-7, 4-5-8) and the FIS-B products it is sent (AIM 4-5-9), each dropped once it is no longer heard. Traffic is for seeing, not avoiding (AIM 4-5-7).

data.description: The bytes received since the last read (whole UDP datagrams), Base64 (RFC 4648).

at.description: Now, Unix s: when the bytes came.

picture.description: The last answer, or null at first.
